title: 第11章 星斗商会第12章 越级擂台
content_zh:
武市，这是整个王都最为繁华，热闹的地方。
灵丹妙药，兵器，灵器，天材地宝，武技功法……关于修炼的一切这里都有的售卖。
有时候，通过一个武市的繁华程度就能看出一个王国是否强大。
镇南王朝历经两百余年，此时正当上升期，所以武市是非常繁华的，不仅有从天南地北倒腾资源的商贩，更有数不清的修炼者。
解决了小翠的江若尘快速融入其中，最终在一座高大庄严的阁楼大门前停下，大门硕大的牌匾上写着四个烫金大字：星斗商会。
这是整个镇南王朝最为庞大的到商会，经营范围不仅在王都，整个镇南王国所有的城镇，以及周别其他的一些国家，都有涉足，实力非常雄厚，王室都敬重三分。
“这的洗髓丹效果最好，就这了。”
江若尘驻足片刻，走了进去。
“您好，请问需要点什么？”
店内立马就迎上一整洁大方的侍女。
“洗髓丹。”
江若尘开门见山。
“先生，里面请。”
侍女闻言，立马就牵引江若尘去到了丹药区域，并且向江若尘介绍了上中下三种品质的洗髓丹。
上品洗髓丹售四块灵石，可温润筋脉两日，中品两块灵石，效果一日。
下品只有短短半日，但也最便宜，只需要一块灵石就能买一颗。
江若尘来时算过，太监送来的加上婉妃售卖首饰换来的灵石，一共也才十块，仅仅只够他购买两颗上品洗髓丹和一颗中品。
“给我来两颗上品，两颗下品吧。”
江若尘思索片刻，将装有全部家当的锦囊交给了侍女。
“好的先生。”

侍女稍作清点，确定没错后就将四盒洗髓丹交给了江若尘。
江若尘好好收纳，这点资源对别人来说可能算不得什么，可对他来说万分重要。
“先生请问还需要些什么吗？我们商会近期来了不少好的兵器以及灵器，您可以看看。”
交易完毕的侍女还向江若尘推销。
江若尘摇摇头拒绝了，“我不用兵器，你们这的武会，今天开吗？我想参加！”
武会，是星斗商会的地下产业，类似于蓝星西方的古角斗场！
很多的普通修士没有修炼资源来源，于是便选择参加武会，通过搏杀的方式获取资源。
在王城严禁动武，很多大族子弟，或一些不缺灵石的大人物没消遣的地方，便会选择观看武会，双方之间就以星斗商会为纽带，形成了类似于角斗场一般的武会。
而江若尘打听武会，自然也是想通过参加武会的方式赚取灵石，兑换修炼资源，这是他出门时就想好的办法。
“武会？对不起先生，这不在我的职责范围之内，如果贵客您有需求的话，我可以为您引荐武会总管。”
侍女回答道。
“那麻烦引荐一下吧。”
江若尘道。
“好。”
见江若尘点头，侍女立马转身离开汇报去了。
江若尘独自待在大厅等待的同时，目光也扫视了一圈整个商会大厅。
发现这星斗商会不愧是镇南王国最大的商会，大厅内的生意应接不暇，光是大厅摆放的好东西就不在少数，很是大手笔。
无意间，江若尘目光扫了一眼门口的位置，却看到几道熟悉的身影正互相交谈从门口走入。
当看清来人样貌后，江若尘有些意外。
因为都是些“熟人。”

十一王子江立，秦琪，其他几位王子公主，以及一些其他大族子弟。
“真是巧啊。”
江若尘心里不由道了一句，而后目光挪开，也不想过多去关注。
“江若尘！”
content_en:
Wu City, this is the most prosperous and lively place in the entire royal capital.
Panacea, weapons, spiritual weapons, heavenly materials and earthly treasures, martial arts techniques... everything about cultivation is sold here.
Sometimes, whether a kingdom is strong can be seen through the prosperity of a military city.
The Zhennan Dynasty lasted for more than two hundred years and was currently on the rise, so Wu City was very prosperous. There were not only traders who were raking in resources from all over the world, but also countless practitioners.
Jiang Ruochen, who had dealt with Xiao Cui, quickly blended in and finally stopped in front of a tall and solemn attic door. On the large plaque on the door were written four gilded characters: Xingdou Chamber of Commerce.
This is the largest chamber of commerce in the entire Zhennan Dynasty. Its business scope is not only in the royal capital, but also in all towns of the entire Zhennan Kingdom, as well as some other countries in the Zhou Dynasty. It is very powerful and the royal family respects it.
"This marrow cleansing pill has the best effect, that's it."
Jiang Ruochen stopped for a moment and walked in.
"Hello, what do you need?"
A neat and elegant maid was immediately welcomed into the store.
"Marrow Cleansing Pill."
Jiang Ruochen got straight to the point.
"Sir, please come inside."
Upon hearing this, the maid immediately led Jiang Ruochen to the elixir area and introduced Jiang Ruochen to the three qualities of marrow-cleansing elixirs: upper, middle and lower.
The top-grade Marrow Cleansing Pill sells four spiritual stones, which can warm and moisturize the veins for two days, while the medium-grade two spiritual stones have an effect of one day.
The lower grade only lasts for half a day, but it is also the cheapest. You only need one spiritual stone to buy one.
Jiang Ruochen calculated when he came here that the total of what the eunuch sent and the spiritual stones that Concubine Wan bought from selling jewelry was only ten yuan, which was only enough for him to buy two top-grade marrow cleansing pills and one medium-grade one.
"Give me two top-grade ones and two low-grade ones."
Jiang Ruochen thought for a moment and handed the bag containing all his belongings to the maid.
"Yes sir."
The maid took a moment to check, and after confirming that they were correct, she handed the four boxes of marrow-cleansing pills to Jiang Ruochen.
Jiang Ruochen took good care of it. This resource might not seem like much to others, but it was extremely important to him.
"Sir, do you need anything else? Our Chamber of Commerce has recently received many good weapons and spiritual weapons. You can take a look."
After completing the transaction, the maid also made a sales pitch to Jiang Ruochen.
Jiang Ruochen shook his head and refused, "I don't use weapons. Is your martial arts meeting going to be held today? I want to participate!"
The martial arts guild is the underground industry of the Star Dou Chamber of Commerce, similar to the ancient gladiatorial arena of Blue Star West!
Many ordinary monks have no source of resources for cultivation, so they choose to participate in martial arts gatherings and obtain resources through fighting.
The use of force is strictly prohibited in the royal city. Many children of wealthy families, or some important figures who are not short of spiritual stones, will choose to watch the martial arts meeting when they have no time to relax. The two parties use the Star Dou Chamber of Commerce as a link to form a martial arts meeting similar to a gladiatorial arena.
When Jiang Ruochen asked about the martial arts meeting, he naturally wanted to earn spiritual stones by participating in the martial arts meeting and exchange them for training resources. This was a method he had thought of when he left home.
"Martial Arts Association? I'm sorry, sir, this is not within the scope of my responsibilities. If you, distinguished guest, are in need, I can introduce you to the general manager of the martial arts association."
the maid replied.
"Then please give me a recommendation."
Jiang Ruochen said.
"Okay."
Seeing Jiang Ruochen nod, the maid immediately turned around and left to report.
While Jiang Ruochen was waiting alone in the hall, he glanced around the entire chamber of commerce hall.
I found that the Xingdou Chamber of Commerce was indeed the largest chamber of commerce in the Zhennan Kingdom. The business in the hall was overwhelming. There were many good things in the hall, which was very generous.
Unintentionally, Jiang Ruochen glanced at the door and saw several familiar figures walking in from the door talking to each other.
Jiang Ruochen was a little surprised when he saw the person's appearance clearly.
Because they are all "acquaintances."
The eleventh prince, Jiang Li, Qin Qi, several other princes and princesses, and some other children of wealthy families.
"realWhat a coincidence. "
Jiang Ruochen couldn't help but say something in his heart, and then looked away, not wanting to pay too much attention.
"Jiang Ruochen! "
